title: QA's repro key for key, from Home with no new workspace: Ctrl+`, Cmd+Shift+L example.com Return, Cmd-Q, reopen, type 'echo hi': the restored browser page has the keyboard, not Home's Chief message box
why: QA chrome-parity-v2-2-2 (bug 1, high; cmux19 and cmux21): after a restart with a browser pane focused, debug.focus says first_responder=FieldTextView, resolved=page (Home's pane), and the typed 'echo AFTER-RESTART' lands in the Chief 'Message' box on Home; Return would send it to Chief. On v2.1 the same steps gave the keys to the sidebar. restart-focus-browser and restart-focus-browser-keys passed on that build because they open a new workspace first (new_terminal or Cmd+N), so Home and its message box are not in the window after the reopen. QA starts from Home: Ctrl+` opens a terminal in the pane beside Home, Cmd+Shift+L opens the browser as a tab of that pane, and the reopened window shows Home again beside the restored browser tab. This journey follows those steps with no new workspace, reopens 5 s after the quit and asks the app nothing for 3 s (QA's capture-host relaunch and its 3 s sleep), then types 'echo hi' (no Return, so nothing is sent to Chief when it fails).
source: independent QA bug (qa-chrome-parity-v2-2-2.json bugs[0]: shots 08-10 on cmux19, 20-22 on cmux21)

steps.title: the app opens on Home: Home's pane has the keyboard model's focus
Ctrl+` from Home made a terminal beside Home that runs the typed command
Cmd+Shift+L opens a browser tab whose address bar takes the keys
before the quit: the browser tab shows example.com and its page has the keyboard
after the reopen, untouched for 3 s: the restored browser page has the keyboard, not Home's message box
the typed keys did not reach Home's message box; the browser page keeps the keyboard
Cmd+Shift+[ selects the restored terminal tab, which takes the keyboard
the restored terminal runs the typed command
